lines.2: This guy's name is Shinichi Samesuga.
lines.3: Since his surname starts with 'shark,' he wants everyone to call him Shark. Instead, the poor sap wound up being called Fukahire--shark fin.
lines.4: 「Listen to this. Yesterday, I finally got as far as going on a date in the park with Keiko.」
lines.6: For the record, he's talking about a dating sim.
lines.7: 「Your parents have been abroad forever, right? Any idea when they're coming back?」
lines.8: 「Yeah. I don't know if it's work or what, but it must be nice, leaving their only child behind.」
lines.9: 「That's a common setup for dating-sim protagonists. Can I call you Dating-Sim Boy?」
lines.10: 「Do those dating-sim protagonists have a male friend who cooks for them?」
lines.11: 「No, that's a little different. Usually it's the childhood friend next door. That's the classic setup.」
lines.16: This dubiously named school is where I study.
lines.17: It used to be a prestigious girls' school called Rindoukan, but it went coed five years ago and got a brand-new name.
lines.18: Almost all the old wooden buildings were replaced with reinforced concrete, too. I like how clean and new it is.
lines.19: Given its history as a girls' school, girls still outnumber boys here, and they wield considerably more power.
lines.20: Even the Student Council President is a girl.
lines.21: 「Hey, there's a bike coming up behind us.」
